title: IcySense — AI Vision Scanner
bodyText: PERCEPTION IcySense STANDBY Tap Start Camera to begin. Identify Icy Ask Start Camera Speak Aim at anything. Tap the orb to identify it. Welcome to IcySense A new way of seeing. One synthesis of origin, mechanism, matter, relationships, time, and the larger systems it belongs to — plus the primitive operations and universal patterns behind it. Ask — Follow-up questions about whatever you scanned. Tap here to start scanning You'll be asked for camera access on the next screen.
